profile.headline: Sr. Principal Software Developer at ManTech
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with expertise in service-oriented architectures, web and client/server application development, and spacecraft software architecture and development for both ground and flight systems.  Advanced degrees in aerospace engineering and computer science. Well versed in agile and traditional development practices. Experience working for both commercial companies and government agencies, including the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the Department of Defense (DOD), and the Department of Justice (DOJ). Active Top Secret security clearance with the United States DOD.
• 19+ years experience in commercial and governmental software engineering.
• 15+ years experience in design and use of relational database systems and SQL.
• 15+ years experience in web application and server technologies.
• 10+ years experience in Java application and server programming.
• 8+ years experience in service oriented architecture (SOA) design and implementation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for large-scale Department of Justice (DOJ) project.  Oversaw complete software cycle development and maintenance.  Responsible for tasking and mentoring junior engineers.  Developed, enhanced, and maintained service-oriented architectures (SOA).  Created and improved upon software development team processes and environment goals.

Lockheed Merit Award for Performance Excellence, 2011.
Lockheed Spot Award for Outstanding Leadership, 2010.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designer, developer, and database administrator (DBA) for the Sundancer manned space complex.  Responsible for the command and telemetry software systems architecture, including inter-service and ground communication.  Implemented a robust, dynamic, distributed on-board services infrastructure.

Design and implementation co-lead and DBA for a remote sensor station network.  Designed and implemented software architecture, along with corresponding data acquisition and control systems using Java, C/C++, Perl, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Responsible for the design and implementation of various bioinformatics software tools, databases, and web services written in Perl, PHP, XHTML, and XML tied to MySQL and PostgreSQL back-ends.  Applications serviced up to 32 different project groups doing research in computational biology, such as the Diabetic Retinopathy Project, the Chloroplast Genome Database, and the Fusarium Database. 

Presented various scientific posters regarding ongoing lab projects, such as the Sequence Management and Analysis Pipeline (SMAPi) and the Fungal Plant Pathogen Database. 

Managed and mentored three (3) undergraduate assistants.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design lead, development lead, and DBA for the command and telemetry database subsystem of NASA’s Deep Impact mission.  Led team’s design and implementation of a reusable command and telemetry information management system for mission spacecraft and instruments.  System managed all commands and telemetry, various flight software files, and the encoding for transferring information from the ground systems to the various spacecraft and instruments.  Work included dynamic data ingestion  and report generation.

Oversaw the successful enhancement and reuse of the command and telemetry system for two subsequent spacecraft programs: DARPA’s Orbital Express NextSat and NASA's Kepler mission. 

Led the design and implementation of the engineering department’s intranet site.

Outstanding Team Performance Award, 2004.
Outstanding Team Performance Award, 2003.
Outstanding Performance Award for Software Process Improvement Initiative, 2003.
Ball Aerospace Service Award, 2003.
Deep Impact Project Award, 2003.

positions.title: Associate Consultant
positions.description:
Developer and graphic designer implementing a business-to-business (B2B) commerce and corporate web site using dynamic stored procedures (PL/SQL, Oracle, XML).
Design lead, developer, and graphics designer for an online survey generation and review service (PL/SQL, Oracle, XML).
Designer, developer, and graphics designer implementing a personalized health care benefits site using JSP architecture (JSP, JavaBeans, Java Servlets, Oracle, XML, DHTML).
Design lead, developer, and graphics designer for public school website (HTML, JavaScript).
Developer and graphics designer for a corporate website (HTML, JavaScript).
Developer for a jobsite employer/candidate matching site (PL/SQL, Oracle).

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Worked extensively as a software quality assurance team member, testing and validating the order-entry and B2B software for an electronics retail corporation.

Involved in project initiation, design, execution, and  maintenance of a comprehensive suite of automated tests used in system testing order entry and e-commerce software using Rational SQA Robot and shell scripting.
